record.body:
## Problem

verify-budget removed the full suite from per-phase verification for cost. There is no regression gate at the phase head, and the phase gate does not require passes at that SHA.

## Approach

decide at discuss — tier-1 affected tests in the inner loop plus one tier-2 full suite per phase at head (GitHub #9); failures become fix tasks via retry-loop.

## Exit criteria

- decide at plan-phase — tier-1 selection, tier-2 background run at head SHA, gate requiring both, and fix-task routing on tier-2 failure hold as verified.
record.subject: tiered-verification
